independence: The reviewer did not author or modify the Theory models or their H-label correction. The reviewer inspected the frozen actual-page images, verified their hashes, and independently compared the model and generator deltas.

scope.scopeLimit: This is a delta review for Theory 42 and chapter V selfcheck 13. It does not claim a new full-course run or review of main exercise 384.

semanticInvariants.generatorOnlyChange: The shared tangent-property piece changes H offset [2,-4] to [0,5.1].
semanticInvariants.method: Parsed comparison of the complete chapter-05-theory model with the baseline, restoring only the two specified offsets. The restored model equals the baseline exactly. The generator differs only by the shared H-offset replacement, and preparation bytes are identical.

visualInspection.method: Every exact full-PNG representative was personally inspected on the 24 contact sheets; mobile captures retain native image size, desktop captures are proportionally reduced without cropping. The two originally failing dense mobile views were also opened as individual original PNGs for each font. Exact duplicates are transferred only within the same full-PNG SHA-256 group.
visualInspection.hClearAssociation: In all H-bearing views H is centered directly above the perpendicular foot on the chord/straight line, inside the circle below the upper arc. It is clear of the chord, circle, point marker, right-angle marker, and equality ticks. Its association with the foot of OH remains unambiguous at both widths in both font environments.
